coverage.surface: Discovery Studio default screen (v4 live-call screen): framework picker, top bar (framework select, call checklist chip, All / Essentials / Recovery), call-state line (account, call status, facts, champion, approver, next step), segment strip, question / buyer responses / suggested response / jump actions, buyer-role alternative questions, After the call, drawer tabs (Objections, Buyer questions, Evidence, Recovery prompts, Facts & signals, Next step)
coverage.note: Read the component, stylesheet, entry file and HTML in full, and all 172 states of the SMB walkthrough generated today (1,537 lines). States the walkthrough does not reach were checked from source and by running the real modules in node (bundled with esbuild from the repository source, nothing mocked except storage): the populated 'What their answers suggested' rows, the tone labels, the pushback flag, champion / approver edits, a reloaded session, Recovery mode with another drawer tab, the empty skip-ahead group (CX AI, Global Contractor Management), and jump actions that target After-the-call questions. Not verified in a browser: keyboard focus order, screen-reader output, layout under 720px.

findings.state: Every framework, all three screen versions. Default screen: select any buyer response, then open 'Facts & signals' → 'What their answers suggested'; or select a pushback answer and watch the Objections tab.
findings.current: projectBranch sets `cls: toBranchTone(legacy.cls) ?? "blu"` (line 249) and toBranchTone accepts only grn | org | red | blu | pur (lines 322-333). The call-script files write every buyer response with tone "ok", "ly" or "fl" (for example js/discovery-segment-runtime.js:106, 110, 114). Running the real loader over the real script files gives: 726 buyer responses loaded, tone distribution {"blu": 726} (the files hold 265 ok, 204 ly, 257 fl). Node tones (pr, fu, ri, va, cl, sl, gr) are also flattened: 258 of 265 questions come out "blu" (line 235).
findings.problem: The tone of a buyer answer is lost when the scripts are loaded, so three things on the default screen cannot work. (1) DiscoveryStudioV4.tsx:161-165 added plain tone labels keyed on ok / ly / fl ('Good sign' / 'Unclear' / 'Warning sign'); none can ever match, so every row under 'What their answers suggested' reads 'Noted' — a list that promises an interpretation and gives none. (2) DiscoveryStudioV4.tsx:116 flags the Objections tab when `branch.cls === "red"`; that is never true, so the tab never surfaces itself when the buyer pushes back. (3) The colour classes `tone-grn / tone-org / tone-red` (discovery-studio-v4.css:96-98) and the branch colour classes in the previous and oldest screens are all blue. A first-time seller gets no good / unclear / warning distinction anywhere.
findings.governing: CLAUDE.md Part I §4.12, Face — 'they push back → the objection auto-appears' and 'tap-what-you-heard → the suggested response'; ANTAEUS_FINAL_AUDIT_CONTROL_PACKET_2026-11-16/antaeus-audit-control/01_OWNER_REQUIREMENTS.md item 7 (functional review of translators and persisted shapes); comprehension principle (a label that always says 'Noted' tells the reader nothing).

No script file changes. Add a case to src/discovery-studio/lib/load-frameworks.test.ts with cls "ok" / "ly" / "fl" expecting grn / org / red.
testsAffected: src/discovery-studio/lib/load-frameworks.test.ts (fixtures use cls 'grn', so nothing fails today; add the ok / ly / fl case)

findings.state: Any load of Discovery Studio after an outcome was chosen in 'After the call' (all three screen versions; the autosaved session holds advanced / stalled / lost / won / no-show).
findings.current: main.tsx:135 starts the call-log effect before the saved session is restored; the effect uses up its 'skip the first run' on the initial value 'in-progress' (call-log.ts:251-258). bootPersistence then restores the session and sets callDisposition to the saved outcome (persistence.ts:141, 455). The effect sees an outcome with no call id and appends a new record stamped with whatever account is in the URL now (call-log.ts:268-285). Executed with the real modules: 1 record after the call; 2, 3 and 4 after three reloads; the fourth, opened from Boeing, was saved as 'Boeing / advanced' although the call was with Ramp.
findings.problem: Every reload of a finished session adds a duplicate completed-call record to gtmos_discovery_call_log, and a reload reached from another account files it under that account. That log is counted by Readiness as discovery calls prepared (src/dashboard/lib/readiness-aggregator.ts:166-175 → src/lib/readiness/dimensions.ts:166-176, '{n} discovery calls prepared' / 'Prepare 8+ discovery calls in Discovery Studio') and feeds Founding GTM's discovery-question section (src/founding-gtm/lib/cross-room.ts:420-446), so both overstate what the seller has done.
findings.governing: CLAUDE.md Part I §4.17 (readiness evidence is present evidence) and §6 (Discovery Studio feeds Readiness and the sales handoff); owner decision in the audit brief §4: 'Numbers shown in more than one area come from the area that owns them'; COPY_STANDARD.md §21 (claims no stronger than the data).
findings.proposed: Record the outcome from the seller's click, not from any change to the signal. In src/discovery-studio/lib/call-log.ts export `commitCallOutcome(disposition)` (the current effect body from line 264 on, keeping the create-or-update logic and the module-level call id) and call it from the outcome buttons (DiscoveryStudioV4.tsx:378). Remove the effect, or keep it but skip while a restore is in progress (set a module flag around seedSignalsFromState in persistence.ts:455 and 450). Save the call id inside the session blob so a restored session updates its own record. Add to src/discovery-studio/lib/call-log.test.ts: start the log, restore a session whose outcome is 'advanced', expect the record count to stay the same.

findings.state: Open Discovery Studio for a second call (same or another account) after any earlier call was autosaved. All three screen versions.
findings.current: There is one saved session per workspace: bootPersistence always restores the latest row and autosave keeps updating that same row (persistence.ts:441-461). The saved state has no account (PersistedSessionState, lines 65-77) and resetSession() (state.ts:662) is never called by any screen; no screen has a control that starts a new call. Executed: opening the screen for Boeing after a call with Ramp showed Ramp's recorded fact, Ramp's next-step owner and the outcome 'advanced' already selected.
findings.problem: A new call starts with the previous call's content. The call-state line reads, for example, 'Boeing · 4 facts recorded · Next step: date, owner, and purpose set' for facts and a next step that belong to another call, 'After the call' shows the earlier outcome as chosen, and '{n} facts recorded during this call' counts earlier calls. The seller has no way to clear it. From the second call on, what the screen says about this call is wrong.
findings.governing: CLAUDE.md Part I §2 (a Call is attached to an account or deal; nouns carry context without restating) and §4.12; COPY_STANDARD.md §21; comprehension principle (the reader must be able to trust what a state or number refers to).
findings.proposed: Smallest fix that does not need a new control: add `accountName: string` to PersistedSessionState (persistence.ts:65), write it from focusedAccount in snapshotSession (line 94), read it in parsePersistedSession with '' as the default for older rows (schemaVersion stays readable), and in bootPersistence restore the session only when the account in the URL is empty or equals the saved accountName (case-insensitive); otherwise leave the signals at their defaults and call startAutoSave(client, null) so the new call gets its own row. OWNER DECISION: add a visible 'Start a new call' control on the After the call step that calls resetSession() and starts a new session row, and decide whether a finished call should still reopen on the next visit.

findings.state: Top bar → 'Recovery', then click any other drawer tab (Objections, Buyer questions, Evidence, Facts & signals, Next step).

findings.state: Top bar chip, every framework. SMB walkthrough: 'Before the call: 0 of 4 set — still missing: account, buyer role, first answer recorded, next-step purpose'; after the first buyer response is selected: 'Before the call: 1 of 4 set — still missing: account, buyer role, next-step purpose'.
findings.current: The four items are account, buyer role, 'first answer recorded' (facts.length > 0) and 'next-step purpose' (lines 219-224). The chip reads `Before the call: {n} of 4 set — still missing: …` and switches to 'Ready for the call' when any three are set (`preflight >= 3`, lines 243-247).
findings.problem: Two of the four items can only be completed during the call (a recorded buyer answer, an agreed next-step purpose). A fully prepared seller is told before dialling that two things are still missing, the chip keeps saying 'Before the call' while answers are being recorded, and 'Ready for the call' can appear with an item — even the account — still missing. The check the screen describes is not the check it runs.
findings.governing: CLAUDE.md Part I §4.11 (salvage item 3) and §4.12 — the pre-call readiness check is 'real person / persona / account context / why-now / linked deal'; COPY_STANDARD.md §21 (claims discipline).
findings.proposed: Smallest accurate change: name the chip for what it counts and show it complete only when it is. Line 247: `${t("Call checklist:")} ${preflight} ${t("of 4 done — still missing:")} ${preflightMissing}`; line 246: `t("Call checklist complete")`; lines 243 and 245: `preflight === preflightItems.length` instead of `preflight >= 3`. OWNER DECISION: replace the four items with the pre-call items in canon (named contact, buyer role, account, reason for the call now, linked deal), read from Signal Console and Deal Workspace, and keep the in-call items in the call-state line.

In DiscoveryStudioV4.tsx add `const actionLabel = (a: { label: string; target: string }): string => a.target.startsWith("node:post-call-routing--") || a.target === "segment:post-call-routing" ? t("Go to After the call") : a.label;` and render `→ {actionLabel(a)}` at line 345 and line 457. findings.state: Readiness (Dashboard → readiness drawer), discovery part: evidence lines '{n} discovery calls recorded with outcome 'advanced'' and '{n} Discovery Studio sessions', and the gaps 'Record 6+ discovery calls with outcome 'advanced'' and 'Run 5+ Discovery Studio sessions'.
findings.current: readDiscoveryStats (lines 177-185) reads gtmos_discovery_stats { advancedCalls, totalCalls }; lines 306-307 pass them on as discoveryAdvancedCalls and discoveryStudioSessions; src/lib/readiness/dimensions.ts:178-202 turns them into the four strings above. Five logged cold calls display as '5 Discovery Studio sessions'; a seller who runs discovery calls here and chooses 'Advanced — dated next step set' never moves either count, so the two gaps can never be closed by doing what they say. A first-time user is told to do something that cannot change the result.
findings.governing: Audit brief §4 (owner decision: 'Numbers shown in more than one area come from the area that owns them'); CLAUDE.md Part I §4.17 (readiness evidence is present evidence) and §6 (Discovery Studio feeds Readiness); COPY_STANDARD.md §21.
findings.proposed: Smallest change that makes the screen accurate without changing what is scored: in src/lib/readiness/dimensions.ts say what is counted — line 181 `{n} cold calls that booked a meeting`, line 188 `Book 6+ meetings from cold calls`, line 195 `{n} calls logged in Cold Call Studio`, line 201 `Log 5+ calls in Cold Call Studio`. OWNER DECISION: count Discovery Studio's own record instead, in readiness-aggregator.ts — discoveryStudioSessions = number of records in gtmos_discovery_call_log, discoveryAdvancedCalls = records whose disposition is 'advanced' or 'won' — and keep today's wording. That changes the inputs to the readiness discovery score (and needs DUI-002 fixed first so reloads do not inflate the count).
testsAffected: src/dashboard/lib/readiness-aggregator.test.ts (lines 150-151 assert the two numbers from gtmos_discovery_stats)

findings.state: Call-state line → click 'Champion: not named yet' or 'Approver: not named yet', type a name, press Enter; then reload, or name the person a second time.
findings.current: The two names live in component signals (`champion`, `signer`, lines 68-69) that are not part of the saved session (src/discovery-studio/lib/persistence.ts:94-108). saveStateName (lines 139-158) also appends a fact 'Champion: <name>' / 'Approver: <name>' — but only when a question is active (`if (node)`, line 149), and it appends a new fact on every edit.

Correcting a name leaves both the old and the new name in the facts list and raises the facts count. A name typed before any step or question has been clicked (the state right after choosing a framework) is recorded nowhere and is lost. The screen contradicts itself about who the champion and approver are.
findings.governing: CLAUDE.md Part II §6 (saved / unsaved must never be ambiguous) and Part I §4.12 (the call-state line keeps champion / signer visible); comprehension principle.
findings.proposed: Derive the two names from the saved facts instead of separate signals: `const championName = [...facts].reverse().find((f) => f.branchIndex === -1)?.fact.replace(/^Champion:\s*/, "") ?? "";` (and -2 / 'Approver:' for the approver), and in saveStateName replace the earlier fact with the same branchIndex instead of appending (`learnedFacts.value = [...learnedFacts.value.filter((f) => f.branchIndex !== idx), { nodeId: node?.nodeId ?? currentNode?.id ?? "", branchIndex: idx, fact, recordedAt: new Date().toISOString() }]`), so a name is recorded even when no question has been clicked yet. No schema change: learnedFacts is already saved.

findings.state: Drawer → 'Facts & signals' → 'Facts from this call', after a buyer response is selected.

findings.state: Capability map for Discovery Studio (embedded in the tester walkthrough as the description of what this area offers).
findings.current: The map states as present: 'Opening … Pre-built from the account's live Signal Console signal → the spoken opener + reason-now'; 'Pre-call readiness check … real person · persona · account context · why-now · linked deal'; 'Flows in: pre-call context read directly from Signal Console (account + signal) + Deal Workspace (deal state)'; '→ Deal Workspace: active framework · learned facts · stakeholder map · … · next-step lock'; 'activeTrack: engaged / guarded / skeptical / deflecting / compressed'; 'callDisposition: Meeting booked / referral / nurture / disqualified / hard pass / in-progress'; compression modes 'Off / Essentials / Emergency'.
findings.problem: None of these match the product. The opening question is the framework's fixed text and no screen reads a signal; the only inbound context is the account name in the address (main.tsx:59-70); the checklist counts account, buyer role, first answer recorded and next-step purpose (DiscoveryStudioV4.tsx:219-224); nothing is passed to Deal Workspace but the account name (handoff.ts:58-64); activeTrack and callDisposition both hold in-progress / advanced / stalled / lost / won / no-show (state.ts:195-201); the buttons read All / Essentials / Recovery. A tester checking the area against its map will look for five things that are not there.
findings.governing: ANTAEUS_FINAL_AUDIT_CONTROL_PACKET_2026-11-16/antaeus-audit-control/00_ANTAEUS_FINAL_AUDIT_CONTROL.md ('Current code shows what the product does'; active doctrine must match); COPY_STANDARD.md §21.
findings.proposed: Mark what is not built instead of describing it as present. In the map: segment 1 — replace 'Pre-built from the account's live Signal Console signal → the spoken opener + reason-now.' with 'The opening question comes from the chosen framework. (Building it from the account's Signal Console signal is not built.)'; section 6 — after 'Signal → spoken call-opener' add '— not built'; 'Pre-call readiness check' → 'Call checklist — account · buyer role · first answer recorded · next-step purpose'; section 7 'Flows in' → 'The account name, passed in the address by the area the seller came from.'; '→ Deal Workspace' and '→ Future Autopsy' rows → 'Opens with the account in focus. OWNER DECISION: build the signal-based opener, the deal context on arrival and the transfer to Deal Workspace instead (see DUI-025).
